summary: The note opens the history of Sacramento, California, stating that the city was founded in 1848 by Samuel Brannan and John Augustus Sutter, Jr. around an embarcadero. That embarcadero had been built by John Sutter, Sr. a few years earlier at the confluence of the American and Sacramento Rivers. The note is a short excerpt and covers only the founding.
one_line: Sacramento's history begins with its 1848 founding by Samuel Brannan and John Augustus Sutter, Jr. at a riverside embarcadero.
key_facts: The history of Sacramento, California, began with its founding by Samuel Brannan and John Augustus Sutter, Jr.
The city was founded around an embarcadero.
The embarcadero was constructed by John Sutter, Sr. a few years before 1848.
The embarcadero was located at the confluence of the American and Sacramento Rivers.
